items.text: Provide evidence that IHAs were completed for Members newly enrolled January 1 to March 31, 2026, whose 120-day IHA window closed in Q2 2026.
Provide evidence of outreach to newly enrolled Members who had not completed an IHA, including the number and type of attempts, for Q2 2026.
Provide the IHA completion report for reporting quarter Q1 2026 (IHA windows closing January 1 to March 31, 2026).
Provide the approved P&P and committee approval establishing periodic re-administration of the IHA in accordance with the PHM Policy Guide.
Provide data showing that periodic IHA re-administration is tracked for Members of all ages in 2026.
Provide evidence that all IHAs completed in Q2 2026 were performed by a Provider within the primary care medical setting.
Provide the communication to Network Providers that specifies which practice settings may perform the IHA.
Provide a 2026 delegation oversight audit confirming that a delegated medical group performs IHAs within the primary care medical setting.
Provide the results of a review of at least 30 Q2 2026 records in which the PCP determined an IHA was not necessary, showing the Medical Record was complete and updated within the prior 12 months.
Provide evidence that PCPs were instructed on the 12-month Medical Record exception and how to document the determination.
Provide evidence that delegated medical groups apply the 12-month PCP-determination standard when closing IHA care gaps without a visit.
Provide the interpreter services log for IHA appointments in Q2 2026.
Provide evidence that IHA health education materials are available in all threshold languages.
Provide attendance records for cultural competency or language access training delivered to PCPs on conducting the IHA in 2026.
Provide Medical Record Review results showing that IHAs are documented in the Member's Medical Record.
Provide evidence that IHAs completed by the telehealth vendor or urgent care centers are documented in the Member's PCP Medical Record.
Provide Medical Record Review results showing that IHAs include a history of the Member's physical and mental health.
Provide the IHA documentation template or tool showing fields for physical and mental health history.
Provide Medical Record Review results showing that IHAs include an identification of risks.
Provide evidence of referrals or follow-up for risks identified during IHAs in Q2 2026.
Provide Medical Record Review results showing that IHAs include an assessment of need for preventive screens or services.
Provide evidence that preventive screening needs were assessed in IHAs for Members under 21 at both directly contracted PCPs and delegated medical groups.
Provide Medical Record Review results showing that health education is provided and documented at the IHA.
Provide the health education materials and program activity that support health education at the IHA.
Provide the communication informing Network Providers that health education is a required component of every IHA.
Provide Medical Record Review results showing that IHAs include the diagnosis and plan for treatment of any diseases.
Provide Medical Record Review results for IHAs rendered by the BrightPath Virtual Care telehealth vendor, including diagnosis and treatment plan.
Provide the P&P describing how IHA requirements are applied for Members dually eligible for Medi-Cal and Medicare.
Provide IHA completion data for dually eligible Members for 2026.
Provide evidence that the SHA/IHEBA requirement was removed from the IHA policy and that Network Providers were told it is no longer required.
Provide evidence that the Medical Record Review tool no longer scores SHA/IHEBA completion.
Provide the MCOD-MCP Submission Portal confirmation showing updated IHA P&Ps were submitted within 90 calendar days of the APL 26-001 release.
Provide evidence that the P&P review against APL 26-001 was completed and the revised P&Ps were approved by committee before submission.
Provide evidence that all P&Ps affected by APL 26-001, including the delegation oversight policy, were submitted to the Portal by April 7, 2026.
Provide a copy of the no-change attestation showing the APL title and APL release date in the subject line.
Provide evidence that the no-change attestation was uploaded to the Portal within 90 calendar days of the APL release.
Provide the completed Compliance quality review verifying that attestation subject-line requirements were met before upload.
Provide DHCS's acceptance or approval of the P&Ps submitted for APL 26-001.
Provide the communication of APL 26-001 requirements to Network Providers.
Provide evidence that APL 26-001 was sent to all Subcontractors, with written acknowledgment from each.
Provide a 2026 delegation oversight audit that evaluated a delegate's compliance with IHA requirements.
Provide evidence that APL 26-001 training was delivered to all delegated medical groups.
